title: FairTabGen: High-Fidelity and Fair Synthetic Health Data Generation from Limited Samples

bias_targets.methodology: Designated as the primary sensitive attribute in a structural causal model, evaluated using counterfactual fairness metrics (Fairness Through Unawareness, Demographic Parity) and composite fairness metrics (ABROCA, TPRD, ERD) on downstream predictive clinical models trained on synthetic tabular data.

Modeled as a confounder in the structural causal model prompt and evaluated by comparing the demographic representation (male vs. female) in the synthetically generated data against the real MIMIC-IV dataset.

Incorporated as a confounder variable in the prompt-based structural causal model to control for its influence on both the sensitive attribute and the target clinical outcome during synthetic data generation.
